# For paper: post process on run_K562.v2.Rmd
v2: 
1. find K562 bcs in whitelist
2. find K562 bcs not in whitelist 
3. filter K562 bcs step2 on coverage >=100 -> produce a list of unique BC with high confidence

v1: 
Post analysis following /ei/projects/0/0ddcec61-75f4-4347-b696-e96ec587183c/data/results/YL/PIP-3583/Analysis/CellBarcode_3.22/plate_UMI_constant/run_K562.v1.Rmd

run1/ read and barcode matching with dist=0

Start on 0/0ddcec61-75f4-4347-b696-e96ec587183c/data/results/YL/PIP-3583/Analysis/CellBarcode_3.22/plate_UMI_constant/K562/run1/plate6_H8.match_whitelist.csv; filter all detected barcodes to remove freq<100. 
Output to run1/filter100/

1. find K562 bcs in whitelist
2. find K562 bcs not in whitelist - unique to K562
3. filter K562 bcs on coverage >=100
4. repeat step 1 and 2.
5. multiple sequence alignment for reads in plate 1-5 associated with top unique K562 bc.


## 1.2. How many whitelist barcodes are found the k562 bc?
```{r}
# compute distance matrix
df.ld <- data.frame(lapply(df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq, function(x){stringdist(df.whitelist$bc, x, method = 'lv')} ))

colnames(df.ld) <- df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq
if (OUTPUT) {
save(df.ld, df.whitelist, df.bc_backbone,file=sprintf('%s/K562/run1/Ld.RData', analysis_root))
}
dim(df.ld)
# [1] 1261 5872

df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist <- data.frame(whitelist=df.whitelist$bc, 
                                        wellid=df.whitelist$wellid, 
                                        reads=0,k562_bc="")

for (row in 1:nrow(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist)){
  if(sum(df.ld[row,]<=1)>0){
    matched_bc.seq <- df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq[df.ld[row,]<=1]
    matched_bc.counts <- df.bc_backbone$count[df.ld[row,]<=1]
    matched_bc.Ld <- df.ld[row,][df.ld[row,]<=1]
    # remove matched_bc
    df.ld[row,df.ld[row,]<=1]=1000
    str1 <- ''
    for (i in 1:length(matched_bc.seq)){
      str1 <- sprintf('%s%s:%d:%d;',str1,matched_bc.seq[i],matched_bc.Ld[i],matched_bc.counts[i])
    }
    df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist[row,"reads"] <- sum(matched_bc.counts)
    df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist[row,"k562_bc"] <- str1
  }
}
# number of bcs matching whitelist (inc with d=1)
sum(df.ld==1000)
# [1] 2637

# how many whitelist bc without NGS support? 
sum(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist$reads==0)
# [1] 21

if (OUTPUT){
  save(df.ld, df.whitelist,df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist,
       df.bc_backbone,file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/Ld.post_matching.RData', analysis_root))
  write.csv(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist, 
            file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/match_whitelist.csv', analysis_root),
            row.names = F, quote = F)
}
```
## 1.3. Many hight freq NGS barcodes do not match to whitelist (3236 bcs in total). 
Note that some will have mismatches to barcode patterns.
```{r}
# many NGS reads do not match to whitelist
load(file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/Ld.RData', analysis_root), verbose = T)
dim(df.ld)
# [1] 1261 5872: row - whitelist, col - k562
k562.not_wl_match_bc <- data.frame()
idx <- c()
for (col in 1:ncol(df.ld)){
  if (sum(df.ld[,col]<=1)==0){
    idx <- c(idx, colnames(df.ld)[col])
  }
}
k562.not_wl_match_bc <- data.frame(bc=idx)
k562.not_wl_match_bc$freq <- unname(sapply(idx, FUN=function(x)
  df.bc_backbone$count[df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq==x]))
if (OUTPUT) {
  write.csv(k562.not_wl_match_bc, 
            file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/NGS_bc_not_match_wl.csv', analysis_root),
            row.names = F, quote = F)
}
# num bc not in white list
dim(k562.not_wl_match_bc)
# [1] 3236    2
```

search bc in plate1-5 raw reads
Prepare for multiple sequence alignment. Firstly put sequences with matching bc into fasta file 
```{r}
# BiocManager::install("msa")
library(msa)
# output seqences to fasta for msa
CON <- file(sprintf('%s/k562/run1/filter100/K_uniq_bc1.fasta', analysis_root), 
            open = 'w')    #Open connection to append
# add top freq read from K562
writeLines(sprintf(">K562_1:freq_%d", tmp_bc.barcode_df$freq[1]), CON)
writeLines(tmp_bc.barcode_df$seq[1],CON)

  # search bc in plate1-5 raw reads
  # search_plateid="plate1"
for (search_plateid in c("plate1", "plate2", "plate3", "plate4", "plate5")) {
  fq_files <- file.path(fastq_dir,sprintf('%s_merged.fastq.gz', search_plateid))
  barcode_df <- read_fastq_gz(fq_files)
  df.fwd_match <- data.frame(matrix(data = NA, nrow = 0,ncol = 2))
  colnames(df.fwd_match) <- c("freq", 'seq')
  # search bc in raw read, fwd version
  if (sum(grepl(tmp_bc, barcode_df$seq))>0){
      idx <- which(!is.na(str_match(barcode_df$seq, tmp_bc)))
      df.fwd_match <- rbind(df.fwd_match, barcode_df[idx,])
  }
  for (row in 1:nrow(df.fwd_match)){
    writeLines(sprintf(">%s_%s:freq_%d", search_plateid, rownames(df.fwd_match)[row],
               df.fwd_match$freq[row]), CON)
    writeLines(df.fwd_match$seq[row],CON)
  }
  
  # search rc read for bc:
  rc <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(x=barcode_df$seq)))
  barcode_df.rc = barcode_df
  barcode_df.rc$seq= rc
  df.rc_match <- data.frame(matrix(data = NA, nrow = 0,ncol = 2))
  colnames(df.rc_match) <- c("freq", 'seq')
  # sum(grepl(tmp_bc, barcode_df.rc$seq))
  if (sum(grepl(tmp_bc, barcode_df.rc$seq))>0){
    idx <- which(!is.na(str_match(barcode_df.rc$seq, tmp_bc)))
    df.rc_match <- rbind(df.rc_match, barcode_df.rc[idx,])
  }
  
  for (row in 1:nrow(df.rc_match)){
    writeLines(sprintf(">%s_%s:freq_%d", search_plateid, rownames(df.rc_match)[row],
               df.rc_match$freq[row]), CON)
    writeLines(df.rc_match$seq[row],CON)
  }
}
close(CON) 


```

search bc in plate1-5 raw reads
```{r}
# search bc in plate1-5 raw reads
for (search_plateid in c("plate1", "plate2", "plate3", "plate4", "plate5")) {
  
  print(search_plateid)
  if (search_plateid!='plate6'){

  } else {

  barcode_df.raw = read_fastq_gz(fq_files)
  barcode_df <- barcode_df.raw[barcode_df.raw$freq>1,]

    idx <- which(!is.na(str_match(barcode_df$seq, tmp_bc)))
    print(barcode_df[idx,])
  }
  
  # search rc read for bc:
  rc <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(x=barcode_df$seq)))
  barcode_df.rc = barcode_df
  barcode_df.rc$seq= rc
  sum(grepl(tmp_bc, barcode_df.rc$seq))
  if (sum(grepl(tmp_bc, barcode_df.rc$seq))>0){
    idx <- which(!is.na(str_match(barcode_df.rc$seq, tmp_bc)))
    print(barcode_df.rc[idx,])

}
```
